## Activity

During March 2019, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 83 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and represents the work submitted for review from the site. The capture count is presented as the principal measure of activity for the month.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 5 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 6.0 per cent. These results indicate that a proportion of the images could not be assessed for grading. The ungradable count and rate should be considered together when reviewing the quality of image acquisition at Hill Counties Health Centre.

## Grading

Grading identified 10 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 7 days. This is the midpoint measure for the time taken for images to proceed from capture to review and grading during March 2019. The referable result total and median lag provide the key grading measures for the reporting period.
